---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - bioconda::hipstr=0.7

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process HIPSTR {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/hipstr:0.7--hcf09f9e_0':
        'quay.io/biocontainers/hipstr:0.7--hcf09f9e_0' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta),  path(alignment_files), path(alignment_indices), path(alignment_file_list)
    tuple val(meta2), path(fasta), path(fai)
    tuple val(meta3), path(ref_regions)
    tuple val(meta4), path(ref_vcf), path(ref_vcf_tbi)
    tuple val(meta5), path(snp_vcf), path(snp_vcf_tbi)
    path stutter_in
    path fam
    path hap_chr_file
    val save_log
    val save_viz
    val save_stutter

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.vcf.gz"),             emit: vcf
    tuple val(meta), path("*.log.txt"),            emit: log, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.viz.gz"),             emit: viz, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.stutter_models.txt"), emit: stutter, optional: true
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('hipstr'), eval("HipSTR --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^HipSTR version //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_hipstr

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    if (alignment_file_list) {
        log.warn "alignment_file_list is less portable: paths inside it are not staged by Nextflow. Use alignment_files + alignment_indices instead."
    }

    def log_arg = save_log ? "--log ${prefix}.log.txt" : ''
    def viz_arg = save_viz ? "--viz-out ${prefix}.viz.gz" : ''
    def stutter_out_arg = save_stutter ? "--stutter-out ${prefix}.stutter_models.txt" : ''

    def ref_vcf_arg = ref_vcf ? "--ref-vcf $ref_vcf" : ''
    def snp_vcf_arg = snp_vcf ? "--snp-vcf $snp_vcf" : ''
    def stutter_in_arg = stutter_in ? "--stutter-in $stutter_in" : ''
    def fam_arg = fam ? "--fam $fam" : ''
    def hap_chr_file_arg = hap_chr_file ? "--hap-chr-file $hap_chr_file" : ''

    def alignment_file_list_arg = alignment_file_list ? "--bam-files $alignment_file_list" : ''
    def bams_arg = alignment_files ? "--bams ${alignment_files.join(',')}" : ''

    """
    HipSTR \\
        $bams_arg \\
        $alignment_file_list_arg \\
        --fasta $fasta \\
        --regions $ref_regions \\
        --str-vcf ${prefix}.vcf.gz \\
        $ref_vcf_arg \\
        $snp_vcf_arg \\
        $stutter_in_arg \\
        $fam_arg \\
        $hap_chr_file_arg \\
        $log_arg \\
        $viz_arg \\
        $stutter_out_arg \\
        $args
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    """
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.vcf.gz
    touch ${prefix}.log.txt
    echo "" | gzip >  ${prefix}.viz.gz
    touch ${prefix}.stutter_models.txt
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/hipstr"
description: "Genotype and phase short tandem repeats using Illumina whole-genome\
  \ sequencing data"
keywords:
- "str"
- "tandem repeats"
- "short tandem repeats"
- "genotyping"
- "bam"
- "cram"
- "vcf"
tools:
- hipstr:
    description: "Haplotype inference and phasing for short tandem repeats"
    homepage: "https://hipstr-tool.github.io/HipSTR/"
    documentation: "https://hipstr-tool.github.io/HipSTR/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/tfwillems/HipSTR"
    doi: "10.1038/nmeth.4267"
    licence:
    - "GPL-2.0"
    identifier: "biotools:hipstr"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample or cohort information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - alignment_files:
      type: "file"
      description: "List of BAM/CRAM files to analyze"
      pattern: "*.{bam,cram}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3462"
  - alignment_indices:
      type: "file"
      description: "Index file(s) for the input BAM/CRAM file(s)"
      pattern: "*.{bai,crai}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3327"
      - edam: "http://ncicb.nci.nih.gov/xml/owl/EVS/Thesaurus.owl#C192224"
  - alignment_file_list:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional file containing BAM/CRAM files to analyze, one per line.\
        \ Used with HipSTR `--bam-files`."
      pattern: "*.txt"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. [ id:'genome'\
        \ ]\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "FASTA file containing all of the relevant sequences for your organism.\n\
        When analyzing CRAMs, this FASTA file must match the file used for compression.\n"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - fai:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional FASTA index file"
      pattern: "*.fai"
      ontologies: []
- - meta3:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
  - ref_regions:
      type: "file"
      description: "BED file containing coordinates for each STR region"
      pattern: "*.bed"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3003"
- - meta4:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
  - ref_vcf:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional bgzipped input VCF file of a reference panel of STR genotypes.\n\
        VCF alleles will be used as candidate variants instead of finding candidates\n\
        in the BAMs/CRAMs.\n"
      pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  - ref_vcf_tbi:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional tabix index for the STR reference panel VCF"
      pattern: "*.vcf.gz.tbi"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
- - meta5:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
  - snp_vcf:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional bgzipped input VCF file containing phased SNP genotypes\
        \ for the samples\nto be genotyped. These SNPs will be used to physically\
        \ phase STRs.\n"
      pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  - snp_vcf_tbi:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional tabix index for the phased SNP VCF"
      pattern: "*.vcf.gz.tbi"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
- stutter_in:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional input file containing stutter models.\nStutter models in\
      \ this file will be used to genotype STRs.\nBy default, HipSTR learns stutter\
      \ models via the EM algorithm.\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
    ontologies:
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
- fam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional FAM file (PLINK sample information file) containing pedigree\
      \ information for samples of interest.\nThe pedigree information is used to\
      \ filter SNPs prior to phasing STRs.\nBy default, all SNPs are used.\n"
    pattern: "*.fam"
    ontologies: []
- hap_chr_file:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional file containing chromosomes to treat as haploid, one per\
      \ line"
    pattern: "*.txt"
    ontologies:
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
- save_log:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to output the log information to the file (Default = Standard\
      \ error)"
- save_viz:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to output a file of each locus' alignments for visualization\
      \ with VizAln or VizAlnPdf"
- save_stutter:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to output stutter models learned by the EM algorithm to\
      \ the file"
output:
  vcf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample or cohort information\ne.g. `[\
          \ id:'sample1' ]`\n"
    - '*.vcf.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Bgzipped VCF file to which STR genotypes are written"
        pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  log:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample or cohort information\ne.g. `[\
          \ id:'sample1' ]`\n"
    - '*.log.txt':
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional file containing HipSTR log information"
        pattern: "*.log.txt"
        ontologies: []
  viz:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample or cohort information\ne.g. `[\
          \ id:'sample1' ]`\n"
    - '*.viz.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional file containing alignments for visualization with VizAln\
          \ or VizAlnPdf"
        pattern: "*.viz.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  stutter:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample or cohort information\ne.g. `[\
          \ id:'sample1' ]`\n"
    - '*.stutter_models.txt':
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional file containing stutter models learned by the EM algorithm"
        pattern: "*.stutter_models.txt"
        ontologies: []
  versions_hipstr:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - hipstr:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - HipSTR --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^HipSTR version //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - hipstr:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - HipSTR --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^HipSTR version //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@KondratievaOlesya"
maintainers:
- "@KondratievaOlesya"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
